views.text: In October 2023, Equity Mates said Atlassian’s purchase of video messaging platform Flume for $975 million showed a bet on remote work tools, highlighting a clear product direction when many firms were pushing for office returns.

episode.title: Why is Atlassian doubling down on WFH, when everyone is going back to the office?

views.text: In August 2021, Equity Mates noted management highlighted rapid cloud momentum and large net new customer additions on an earnings call, indicating strong adoption of Atlassian’s products.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In May 2026, Equity Mates discussed that recent results, including a stronger-than-expected report from Atlassian, suggested switching costs and operational inertia can protect established software, tempering fears of rapid AI-driven replacement.

episode.title: Why private equity investors aren’t panicking about AI

views.text: In May 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said Atlassian performed well and that workflow orchestration and developer tools may fare better, as tools with workflow lock-in are more resilient than manual, easily replaced software.

episode.title: How AI improves the investing process with Arms Rosenberg

views.text: In March 2026, a guest on Equity Mates argued parts of Atlassian’s lineup, citing Trello, looked highly susceptible to AI disruption, stressing that vulnerability risk was real even if pricing outcomes were a separate question.
